svg.title: FOI current document processing architecture
svg.desc: Upload routes to conditional conversion or direct deduplication. Dedupe starts compression and page counting independently. Successful PDF compression publishes OCR work best effort through Redis, then ActiveMQ, Azure OCR and an OCR status callback. Grouped data access shows object storage and document databases.

text.tspan: Current implementation described in the supplied September 2026 findings
Binary stored before work is queued
Hash, page information and document state
Does not wait for compression or OCR
Record dispatch state; guard terminal jobs
Poll OCR, upload result, report status
Create initial job and document records
Queues carry references, not document bytes
Page count · OCR dispatch · Azure OCR
Grouped data access view of the services at left
parent / child relationships and output paths
OCR audit API / reviewer data layer
Persist OCR lifecycle state and output path
Exact audit API hosting boundary is not specified.
Normal / large labels represent logical routes; deployed keys may differ. Shared data access is grouped to avoid crossing the workflow.
Review exposure is a logical data relationship, not a claimed direct database connection. No target architecture or undocumented recovery settings are shown.
